# Contributing Guidelines

Thank you for your interest in contributing to this project.

This is a private and controlled codebase. Contributions are accepted only with prior authorization.

## Workflow
1. Create a feature or fix branch:
    - feature/description
    - fix/description

2. Follow existing coding standards and project architecture.

3. Submit a Pull Request for review.

## Code Standards
- Follow PSR-12 standards
- Maintain clean and readable code
- Avoid introducing breaking changes

All contributions are subject to review and approval.

For access or collaboration requests, contact:
